provenance: image-derived-estimate: landmark pixel reads off the operator-local reference photograph at +/-10 px uncertainty; single-camera perspective slightly below and left of the sculpture; every ratio is an image-derived estimate, NOT physical 3D truth. The +/-20% bands are what absorb the unquantified foreshortening. Approved by the operator with FF-A2 plan v3/v4 (ADR-066).

source_image.coordinate_origin: top-left pixel, x right, y down
source_image.note: the image itself is operator-local, gitignored and dockerignored (ADR-064 owner amendment 1); this text record is the only committed artifact

bands.band_rule: measured central value +/- 20% (the 20% width is a judgement value [J] absorbing perspective + the +/-10 px read uncertainty; tighten only by operator ruling)

width_height_ratio.enforcement: freeform_loop.validate() refuses every parameter combination outside this band (v4 s.C)

through_opening_preserved.enforcement: freeform_loop.validate() refuses combinations whose estimated void collapses below the 316L clearance floor; the topology contract requires exactly one through-opening

fixture_fidelity_checks.note: asserted by gate_ffa2_auto on the acceptance fixture ONLY (v4 s.C); they are fidelity-to-reference-08 checks, not general primitive constraints

derivation.ruling: owner option (a), 2026-09-05 (ADR-066): band re-derived from the reference image under the SAME deterministic projection instrument; +/-20% around the exact instrument result 122/139 = 0.877698
derivation.formula: max(rim_left, rim_right at the void-centroid ROW, measured outward from the void bbox) / (occupied run downward from the silhouette top at the void-centroid COLUMN)
derivation.camera_orientation: single perspective photograph, camera slightly below and left of the sculpture, front-ish view; projection along the view axis
derivation.raster: native pixel grid 1280x959, 1 px cells, origin top-left, y down (geometry side: 10 mm cells of the tessellation front projection)

segmentation_rule.pixel_class: sculpture := mean(R,G,B) >= 160 AND max channel difference <= 20 (int RGB)
segmentation_rule.morphology: binary closing, 3x3 square, 1 iteration (heals thin dark seam-line punctures; no-op on the clean geometry mask)
segmentation_rule.silhouette: largest 4-connected component of the classified pixels
segmentation_rule.note: the polygon excludes the bright white facade rail that merges with the sculpture's upper-right edge in this photograph — a recorded acquisition step for the photo medium only

derivation.scope: a PROJECTION metric only — passing it claims NOTHING about the reference's 3-D apex scoop and rim shaping, which remain a separate mandatory visual-gate comparison (owner ruling)

rim_ratio_HISTORICAL.status: RETIRED as an automatic check by owner ruling 2026-09-05 — preserved as historical evidence, not erased
rim_ratio_HISTORICAL.original_pixels: 110 px widest rim / 55 px narrowest rim (apex)
rim_ratio_HISTORICAL.why_retired: the 55 px apex reading measured the thin band beside the reference's 3-D concave surface SCOOP — a shading/surface feature invisible in any front projection; no projection instrument reproduces the 110/55 pair (the reference itself scored ~0.64-0.88 under projection instruments), so the band was incompatible with the automatic front-projection metric. It failed gate_ffa2_auto 1-of-60 on 2026-09-05 (definitive transcript, ADR-066) before the ruling; that FAIL is preserved as history. The scoop itself remains a mandatory VISUAL-gate comparison.

twist_direction.enforcement: sign of section_twist_deg on the acceptance fixture

base_contact_width_fraction.note: the photo lands near-tangent; the measurable interface plate is a deliberate engineering deviation ordered by the owner's base-interface amendment (v4 s.A.2) - this figure only guides the default plate diameter

not_measurable_from_this_photo: material or process (316L is the SELECTED PROTOTYPE MANUFACTURING HYPOTHESIS, an owner ruling - not an image fact)
